notes.title: Infinite Widgets 1.0.13 & 1.0.14
notes.content:
Features : 

 Now possible to create a Lua Script component directly from Lua (Doc)
 Easier removal of components via Lua (Doc)
 Added new string conversion functions
 New function to retrieve an element's bounds (Doc)
 New Rect class (Doc)
 Added new functions for generating random colors/gradients (Doc)
 Elements can now be renamed using Lua
 Now possible to add the same value multiple times to a chart via Lua (Doc)
 Improved mouse wheel handling in the Live Tab when the mouse is captured by an element


Bug fixes : 

 Fixed a crash with the cache system


Next update : 
The next update will include support for Windows theme informations (dark or white theme, accent colors...)

Thank you for your support !

notes.title: Infinite Widgets 1.0.12
notes.content:
Features : 

 New Lua global Path (documentation here)
 New function windows.getFileRender to retrieve a file thumbnail (documentation here)


Bug fixes : 

 DockApp now correctly applies the given ContentMargin
 Fixed crash when opening the Resource menu

Thank you for your support !

notes.title: Infinite Widgets 1.0.11
notes.content:
It is now possible to manipulate individual application volume (documentation here)
Added lowercase variants for CPU, GPU, and MOBO
windows.getAppFromProcessName(..) is now correctly returning a WinApp

Thank you for your support !

notes.title: Infinite Widgets is here !
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45101943/a1f4f1f010854ce9b8dca9811d7d2623e57946da.png

Infinite Widgets is now officially available on Steam !

We are thrilled to see the amazing widgets you'll create and share with the community !

You can check out the Infinite Widgets documentation to learn how to get started on your widget creation journey here.

If you encounter any bugs, issues, or have feedback to share, feel free to contact us through the Infinite Widgets Steam Community Hub or via email at contact@infinitewidgets.net.



Thank you for joining us on this journey, we can't wait to see what you’ll build !
